title: Berry Resources
description: Berry Resources lets you grow vanilla and modded resources through the power of berries!
body:
Welcome to the Custom Berries Mod! This mod introduces a brand-new way to gather resources in Minecraft through 12 custom berry types, each with its own crafting and harvesting system. These berries can be collected from custom bushes, providing an alternative to traditional resource-gathering methods.

Key Features:
12 Custom Berries: Each berry type provides unique resources, ranging from ores to custom items.

Custom Crafting: Each berry has its own crafting recipes, allowing you to create new objects and resources from the berries you harvest.

Immersive Engineering Compatibility: Seamless integration with Immersive Engineering, allowing you to use these berries in Immersive Engineering machines and systems.

Botany Pot Compatibility: Custom berries can also be grown in Botany Pots, providing automatic and easy harvesting in your Minecraft world.

Dive into this new adventure where you can turn your harvest into valuable resources and explore unique crafting possibilities!
